items.source: Although we recommend to use immutable mapping and constructs wherever possible, there are some limitations when it comes to mapping. Given a bidirectional relationship where A has a constructor reference to B and B has a reference to A, or a more complex scenario. This hen/egg situation is not solvable for Spring Data Neo4j. During the instantiation of A it eagerly needs to have a fully instantiated B, which on the other hand requires an instance (to be precise, the same instance) of A. SDN allows such models in general, but will throw a MappingException at runtime if the data that gets returned from the database contains such constellation as described above. In such cases or scenarios, where you cannot foresee what the data that gets returned looks like, you are better suited with a mutable field for the relationships.
items.translation: 尽管我们建议尽可能使用不可变映射和构建方式，但在映射方面仍存在某些限制。 假设存在一个双向关系：其中 A 对 B 拥有构造函数引用，而 B 又对 A 拥有引用；或者场景更为复杂。 这种“先有鸡还是先有蛋”的困境对于 Spring Data Neo4j 而言是无法解决的。 在实例化 A 时，它急切地需要一个完全实例化的 B，而另一方面，B 又需要一个实例（更准确地说，是同一个 A 的实例）。 SDN 通常允许此类模型，但如果从数据库返回的数据包含上述描述的结构，则会在运行时抛出 MappingException。 在无法预知返回数据具体形态的情况下或场景中，使用可变字段来表示关系更为合适。

items.source: Every time the name parameter is either not part of the result or its value is null, then the name defaults to unknown.
items.translation: 每次 `name` 参数不在结果中或其值为 `null` 时，`name` 默认为 `unknown`。

items.source: If the property is immutable but exposes a wither method (see below), we use the wither to create a new entity instance with the new property value.
items.translation: 如果属性是不可变的但暴露了 wither 方法（见下文），我们使用 wither 来创建一个具有新属性值的新实体实例。

items.source: Use factory methods instead of overloaded constructors to avoid @PersistenceCreator — With an all-argument constructor needed for optimal performance, we usually want to expose more application use case specific constructors that omit things like auto-generated identifiers etc. It’s an established pattern to rather use static factory methods to expose these variants of the all-args constructor.
items.translation: 使用工厂方法替代重载构造函数，以避免使用 @PersistenceCreator——由于全参构造函数对于最佳性能是必需的，我们通常希望暴露更多针对特定应用场景的构造函数，这些构造函数会省略诸如自动生成的标识符等内容。采用静态工厂方法来暴露全参构造函数的各种变体，是一种成熟的模式。

items.source: Use Lombok to avoid boilerplate code — As persistence operations usually require a constructor taking all arguments, their declaration becomes a tedious repetition of boilerplate parameter to field assignments that can best be avoided by using Lombok’s @AllArgsConstructor.
items.translation: 使用 Lombok 避免样板代码——由于持久化操作通常需要包含所有参数的构造函数，其声明往往沦为繁琐的样板式参数到字段赋值重复工作，而使用 Lombok 的 @AllArgsConstructor 可最佳地避免此类问题。

When Spring Data detects a constructor with parameter defaulting, then it leaves these parameters absent if the data store does not provide a value (or simply returns null) so Kotlin can apply parameter defaulting. Consider the following class that applies parameter defaulting for name

items.source: If there are multiple constructors taking arguments, the one to be used by Spring Data will have to be annotated with @PersistenceCreator.
items.translation: 如果存在多个带参数的构造函数，Spring Data 将使用的构造函数必须标注为@PersistenceCreator。

items.source: The value resolution assumes constructor argument names to match the property names of the entity, i.e. the resolution will be performed as if the property was to be populated, including all customizations in mapping (different datastore column or field name etc.). This also requires either parameter names information available in the class file or an @ConstructorProperties annotation being present on the constructor.
items.translation: 值解析假设构造函数参数名称与实体的属性名称相匹配，即解析过程将如同填充该属性一样执行，包括所有映射自定义（如不同的数据存储列或字段名等）。 此外，还要求类文件中提供参数名称信息，或者在构造函数上存在 `@ConstructorProperties` 注解。

items.source: Similarly to our optimizations in object construction we also use Spring Data runtime generated accessor classes to interact with the entity instance.
items.translation: 与我们在对象构建优化中采用的方式类似，我们也使用 Spring Data 运行时生成的访问器类来与实体实例进行交互。

items.source: Types must not reside in the default or under the java package.
items.translation: 类型不得位于默认包或java包下。

items.source: Types and their constructors must be public
items.translation: 类型及其构造函数必须是public的。

items.source: Types that are inner classes must be static.
items.translation: 作为内部类的类型，必须是static的。

items.source: The used Java Runtime must allow for declaring classes in the originating ClassLoader. Java 9 and newer impose certain limitations.
items.translation: 所使用的 Java 运行时必须允许在源 `ClassLoader` 中声明类。 Java 9 及更高版本施加了某些限制。

items.source: Try to stick to immutable objects — Immutable objects are straightforward to create as materializing an object is then a matter of calling its constructor only. Also, this prevents your domain objects from being littered with setter methods that allow client code to manipulate the objects state. If you need those, prefer to make them package protected so that they can only be invoked by a limited amount of co-located types. Constructor-only materialization is up to 30% faster than properties population.
items.translation: 尽量使用不可变对象——创建不可变对象非常简单，只需调用其构造函数即可完成对象的实例化。此外，这还能防止你的领域对象充斥着允许客户端代码操纵对象状态的 setter 方法。如果确实需要这些方法，建议将其设为包级私有（package protected），以便仅由有限的同包类型调用。仅通过构造函数进行对象实例化的速度比属性填充快高达 30%。

items.source: Provide an all-args constructor — Even if you cannot or don’t want to model your entities as immutable values, there’s still value in providing a constructor that takes all properties of the entity as arguments, including the mutable ones, as this allows the object mapping to skip the property population for optimal performance.
items.translation: 提供一个全参构造函数——即使您无法或不愿将实体建模为不可变值，提供接受实体所有属性（包括可变属性）作为参数的构造函数仍然具有价值，因为这允许对象映射跳过属性填充过程，从而实现最佳性能。

items.source: Make sure you adhere to the constraints that allow the generated instantiator and property accessor classes to be used
items.translation: 请确保遵守相关约束条件，以便生成的实例化器和属性访问器类能够正常使用。

items.source: For identifiers to be generated, still use a final field in combination with a wither method
items.translation: 若要生成标识符，仍需使用最终字段并结合 wither 方法

items.translation: 该类实际上是不可变的。它允许创建新实例，因为 Kotlin 会生成一个 `copy(…)` 方法，该方法通过复制现有对象的所有属性值，并将作为参数提供的属性值应用其中，来创建新的对象实例。

items.source: This section covers the fundamentals of Spring Data object mapping, object creation, field and property access, mutability and immutability.
items.translation: 本节涵盖 Spring Data 对象映射、对象创建、字段和属性访问以及可变性与不可变性的基础知识。

items.source:
Core responsibility of the Spring Data object mapping is to create instances of domain objects and map the store-native data structures onto those.
This means we need two fundamental steps:
items.translation:
Spring Data 对象映射的核心职责是创建领域对象实例，并将存储原生的数据结构映射到这些对象上。
这意味着我们需要两个基本步骤：

items.source: Instance creation by using one of the constructors exposed.
items.translation: 通过暴露的构造函数之一创建实例。

items.source: Instance population to materialize all exposed properties.
items.translation: 实例化以呈现所有已暴露的属性。

items.source:
Spring Data automatically tries to detect a persistent entity’s constructor to be used to materialize objects of that type.
The resolution algorithm works as follows:
items.translation:
Spring Data 会自动尝试检测持久化实体中用于实例化该类型对象的构造函数。
解析算法的工作方式如下：

items.source:
If there is a no-argument constructor, it will be used.
Other constructors will be ignored.
items.translation:
如果有无参构造函数，将使用它。  
其他构造函数将被忽略。

items.source: If there is a single constructor taking arguments, it will be used.
items.translation: 如果存在一个接受参数的构造函数，它将使用该构造函数。

items.source:
To avoid the overhead of reflection, Spring Data object creation uses a factory class generated at runtime by default, which will call the domain classes constructor directly.

items.translation:
为避免反射带来的开销，Spring Data 默认使用在运行时生成的工厂类来创建对象，该工厂类将直接调用领域类的构造函数。
即对于此示例类型：

items.translation: 我们将在运行时创建一个语义上与此工厂类等效的工厂类：

items.source:
This gives us a roundabout 10% performance boost over reflection.
For the domain class to be eligible for such optimization, it needs to adhere to a set of constraints:
items.translation:
这为我们带来了比反射间接高出约 10% 的性能提升。  
要使领域类符合此类优化的条件，它需要遵守一组约束：

items.source: it must not be a private class
items.translation: 它不能是私有类。

items.source: it must not be a non-static inner class
items.translation: 它不能是非静态内部类。

items.source: it must not be a CGLib proxy class
items.translation: 它不能是 CGLib 代理类。

items.source: the constructor to be used by Spring Data must not be private
items.translation: Spring Data 所使用的构造函数不能是私有的。

items.source: If any of these criteria match, Spring Data will fall back to entity instantiation via reflection.
items.translation: 如果满足上述任一条件，Spring Data 将回退到通过反射进行实体实例化。

items.source:
Once an instance of the entity has been created, Spring Data populates all remaining persistent properties of that class.
Unless already populated by the entity’s constructor (i.e. consumed through its constructor argument list), the identifier property will be populated first to allow the resolution of cyclic object references.
After that, all non-transient properties that have not already been populated by the constructor are set on the entity instance.
For that we use the following algorithm:
items.translation:
一旦创建了该实体的实例，Spring Data 会填充该类中所有剩余的持久化属性。  
除非这些属性已由实体构造函数填充（即通过构造函数参数列表传入），否则标识符属性将被首先填充，以便解析循环对象引用。  
随后，所有未被构造函数填充的非瞬态属性将被设置到实体实例上。  
为此，我们采用以下算法：

items.translation: 如果定义了属性访问（即通过 getter 和 setter 进行访问），我们将调用 setter 方法。

items.source: By default, we set the field value directly.
items.translation: 默认情况下，我们直接设置字段值。

This gives us a roundabout 25% performance boost over reflection.
For the domain class to be eligible for such optimization, it needs to adhere to a set of constraints:

这使我们获得了比反射间接高出约 25% 的性能提升。  
要使领域类符合此类优化的条件，它必须遵守一组约束：

items.source: By default, Spring Data attempts to use generated property accessors and falls back to reflection-based ones if a limitation is detected.
items.translation: 默认情况下，Spring Data 会尝试使用生成的属性访问器；如果检测到限制，则回退到基于反射的访问器。

items.source: 1 The identifier property is final but set to null in the constructor. The class exposes a withId(…) method that’s used to set the identifier, e.g. when an instance is inserted into the datastore and an identifier has been generated. The original Vertex instance stays unchanged as a new one is created. The same pattern is usually applied for other properties that are store managed but might have to be changed for persistence operations. 2 The firstname and lastname properties are ordinary immutable properties potentially exposed through getters. 3 The age property is an immutable but derived one from the birthday property. With the design shown, the database value will trump the defaulting as Spring Data uses the only declared constructor. Even if the intent is that the calculation should be preferred, it’s important that this constructor also takes age as parameter (to potentially ignore it) as otherwise the property population step will attempt to set the age field and fail due to it being immutable and no wither being present. 4 The comment property is mutable is populated by setting its field directly. 5 The remarks properties are mutable and populated by setting the comment field directly or by invoking the setter method for 6 The class exposes a factory method and a constructor for object creation. The core idea here is to use factory methods instead of additional constructors to avoid the need for constructor disambiguation through @PersistenceCreator. Instead, defaulting of properties is handled within the factory method.
items.translation: 1 标识符属性为 final 类型，但在构造函数中被设置为 null。该类提供了一个 withId(…) 方法用于设置标识符，例如当实例被插入数据存储且已生成标识符时。原始的 Vertex 实例保持不变，因为会创建一个新的实例。通常对其他由存储管理的属性也采用相同的模式，但在持久化操作中可能需要对此进行调整。 2 firstname 和 lastname 属性是普通的不可变属性，可能通过 getter 方法暴露。 3 age 属性是不可变的派生属性，源自 birthday 属性。按照所示的设计，数据库值将优先于默认值，因为 Spring Data 仅使用声明的构造函数。即使意图是优先采用计算结果，也重要的是该构造函数必须包含 age 作为参数（以便潜在地忽略它）；否则，属性填充步骤将尝试设置 age 字段，但由于其不可变且不存在 wither 方法而失败。 4 comment 属性是可变的，通过直接设置其字段进行填充。 5 remarks 属性是可变的，可以通过直接设置 comment 字段或调用 setter 方法进行填充。 6 该类提供了一个工厂方法和一个构造函数用于对象创建。这里的核心思想是使用工厂方法而不是额外的构造函数，以避免通过 @PersistenceCreator 进行构造函数消歧的需要。相反，属性的默认值处理在工厂方法内部完成。

items.source: 1 PropertyAccessor’s hold a mutable instance of the underlying object. This is, to enable mutations of otherwise immutable properties. 2 By default, Spring Data uses field-access to read and write property values. As per visibility rules of private fields, MethodHandles are used to interact with fields. 3 The class exposes a withId(…) method that’s used to set the identifier, e.g. when an instance is inserted into the datastore and an identifier has been generated. Calling withId(…) creates a new Vertex object. All subsequent mutations will take place in the new instance leaving the previous untouched. 4 Using property-access allows direct method invocations without using MethodHandles.
items.translation: 1 PropertyAccessor 持有底层对象的可变实例。这是为了能够修改原本不可变的属性。 2 默认情况下，Spring Data 使用字段访问方式来读写属性值。根据 private 字段的可见性规则，使用 MethodHandles 与字段进行交互。 3 该类提供了一个 withId(…) 方法，用于设置标识符，例如当实例被插入数据存储且已生成标识符时。调用 withId(…) 会创建一个新的 Vertex 对象。随后的所有修改都将在新实例中进行，而不会改变之前的实例。 4 使用属性访问允许直接调用方法，而无需使用 MethodHandles。
